decisions.reason: As a classic handle line in the firm's core hardware range, it still fits long-lived specification business, though its age and lack of recent website visibility create some portfolio-rationalization risk.
This lever-handle family supports the firm's broad design and budget coverage, so a large German supplier would usually retain it unless clear overlap or weak demand justified pruning.

A single handle design is easier to discontinue than a full family and the absent later visibility raises doubt, but it still matches the firm's design-led core offer so keeping it remains slightly more likely.
A multi-model lever-handle family strengthens assortment breadth and project specification flexibility, which are central to the firm's position, making withdrawal relatively unlikely.

The electronic access system remains closely aligned with the firm's strategic move toward integrated digital building solutions, so management would be more likely to update or extend it than remove it.
